# SpikeRatePrecisionTradeoff

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The tradeoff between spike rate encoding precision and temporal latency/energy efficiency, where higher precision requires more spikes but increases conversion error accumulation. Guides parameter selection in iNEST hardware to balance accuracy and energy constraints for edge neuromorphic control.
